problem.explanation: WHERE removes products at or below the threshold and ORDER BY stock_qty DESC puts the largest inventory first. A common mistake is using >= 10 when the requirement says more than 10. An index on stock_qty may help selective inventory queries.
hints: Project only name and stock_qty, then order descending.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT name, stock_qty FROM products WHERE stock_qty > 10 ORDER BY stock_qty DESC
problem.statement_markdown: Return product name and stock_qty for products with more than 10 units in stock. Sort largest stock first.
problem.title: Products with stock above threshold
